caramel_background.rule: On Caramel backgrounds, text MUST ALWAYS be Cream/White or Dark Chocolate. Gold text is strictly forbidden due to insufficient APCA contrast ratio.

cream_background.rule: On Cream backgrounds, all body text, over-lines, and headings must use Dark Chocolate or Charcoal. Gold is permitted ONLY for decorative SVG lines or icon strokes with >= 2px width.

chocolate_background.rule: On Dark Chocolate backgrounds, text must be Cream or High-Contrast Champagne Gold (#E5C99F) to guarantee readability.

organic_design_language.curved_section_dividers: Use custom organic SVG wave/curve dividers between contrasting background sections (e.g. SVG path transitioning from Cream to Chocolate or Caramel).
organic_design_language.overlapping_rounded_blocks: Apply generous top border radii (e.g., rounded-t-[2.5rem] md:rounded-t-[4rem]) with negative top margin (-mt-8 or -mt-12) and elevated z-index so sections soft-overlap each other like organic layers.
organic_design_language.blob_backgrounds: Use subtle SVG organic blob shapes behind portrait photos, benefit cards, and callout statistics to create a soft psychological human touch.
organic_design_language.psychology_squiggle_lines: Integrate fine gold continuous line art ('squiggle' / traços de conexão mental / Rorschach-inspired fluid strokes) that trace on scroll or gently float as decorative accents in section margins.
